propositions: Three separate verifier code paths (verify.py, completion.py, code-review.yaml) break the default provider by comparing model to DEFAULT_MODEL instead of resolving the configured standard class.

The equality rule silently fails for provider-qualified model ids (e.g. anthropic:claude-opus-4-8), causing verifier to keep frontier model even when standard class is configured to a different provider.

Code-review's verify step declares no model key and temperature:0 for greedy Pass-2 determinism, but the step runs on frontier due to falling through to cfg.model, making the temperature setting ineffective.
Resolve_model() in config.py does not call resolve_model_string() to resolve class names (trivial/standard/frontier), preventing YAML keys like model:standard from taking effect.

Four independent call sites (verify.py, _verifier_cfg, completion, code-review.yaml) need wiring to a single resolve_model_string() function that maps reserved class names through load_class_slots() while passing through literal model ids unchanged.
